title: Batch 9 review leftovers: Other() semantics, newState test, cites
description:
Minor findings from batch 9 adversarial review (HEAD df7e2035).
1. kgx2 (870006ef): jmap-chat-filenode-server member_permissions/TIERS compare ChatPermission::as_str(), so a hand-built everyone set containing Other("manage_space") grants there, while vtc/federation/memory compare by enum equality and do not. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] says an Other spelling of a known name 'can deny but never grant'; that holds only for resolve_channel_permissions. Fix: document filenode's wire-string semantics or narrow the CHANGELOG sentence (or make filenode compare by variant).
2. 0x0q.64 (fbc9520b): commit and CHANGELOG say the lost-race and cleanup-failed branches of chat_set duplicate-direct now advance newState; no test asserts it (crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/integration.rs). Add a test with RFC 8620 §5.1 as oracle.
3. 0x0q.60 (0925379d): crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs header L5-8 still says 'line numbers at HEAD' and two unpinned cites (e.g. L205 'L194') are wrong at 33702a5; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/presence_delivery.rs header L4-7 still names wss:269, wss:293, chat:1557 at 91672c9. Re-pin to 33702a5.
close_reason: Batch 10: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at d9d4d6af
